title: 第1963章 确实好吃第1962章 相谈甚欢
slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
飞阁在云海中穿行三日，终于在第四日清晨，一座巍峨巨城的轮廓从天际线上浮现出来。
玄煌城，
即便隔着万里之遥，江尘也能感受到那座城池散发出的磅礴气息。
整座城池依山而建，城墙高逾千丈，通体由一种暗金色的石料砌成，飞阁在城外百里处降下云头，虞紫鸢将这座飞行法器收回，
到了城门前，江尘才真正体会到这座城池的雄伟。
千丈高的城门大开，来往修士络绎不绝，其中不乏界皇强者，偶尔还能看到帝尊级的存在掠过天际，在城门外便按下遁光，规规矩矩地排队入城。
“玄煌城禁止飞行，帝尊以下皆需步行入城。”
虞紫鸢解释道，
“这是上古时期便定下的规矩，至今无人敢违。”
江尘点头，目光扫过城门两侧那两尊高达百丈的石像，虽经历了无尽岁月，依旧散发着令人心悸的威压，
绝非寻常石像，而是以某种上古秘法炼制的守护傀儡，一旦有强敌入侵，便会苏醒迎敌。
入城后，虞紫鸢驾轻就熟地带着江尘穿过数条繁华街道，来到一处占地极广的灵府前。
掌柜是个须发皆白的老者，界皇一重的修为，一双眼睛却透着精明，见两人进门，他立刻堆起笑容迎了上来。
“两位道友，可是要租赁灵府？”
虞紫鸢微微颔首：
“一间上等灵府，租期七日。”
掌柜的目光在两人身上一扫而过，尤其是在虞紫鸢脸上停留了一瞬，饶是他见多识广，眼中也不禁闪过一丝惊艳。
但他很快收敛心神，取出一个玉简查阅了一番。
“巧了，天字九号院正好空着，七日租金七百枚玄晶，不知二位...”
话未说完，虞紫鸢已经将玄晶放在柜台上，动作随意得仿佛只是扔出了几块碎石，

掌柜的瞳孔微微一缩，态度立刻恭敬了几分。能如此随意拿出七百玄晶的人，绝非寻常修士。
“二位稍候，老朽亲自带二位前去。”
天字九号院坐落在灵府深处，独门独院，占地不下百亩，院中灵假山流水相映成趣，灵气比许多仙境还要浓郁，
掌柜将玉牌交到虞紫鸢手中，又道：
“二位道友来得巧，三日后的星辉宝阙拍卖会，据说有数件难得一见的至宝会出场，若是二位有兴趣，老朽可以代为安排席位。”
虞紫鸢与江尘对视一眼，轻声道：
“有劳掌柜了。”
掌柜摆手笑道：
“举手之劳，对了，二位若是闲暇，不妨去城中的坊市走走。
玄煌城的坊市在这一片区域里可是首屈一指，尤其是西市的散修坊，虽说比不得那些大拍卖行，但有时也能淘到些意外之喜。”
送走掌柜，虞紫鸢站在院中，看向江尘：
“道友伤势未愈，不如先在灵府中调息一日，明日再去坊市不迟。”
江尘摇头道：
“没事，这几日修养已经恢复得差不多了，正想出去走走，看看这玄煌城风物也不错。”
虞紫鸢微微一笑，没有再劝，
只是稍作停留，让那几个侍女收拾了下住处，两人便出了灵府，向着掌柜所说的西市坊走去。
玄煌城的主街宽逾百丈，两侧楼阁林立，每一座都散发着不凡的灵力波动。
街道上修士来来往往，修为最低的也在星主境以上，界皇修士更是随处可见，甚至偶尔能看到帝尊级别的强者昂然而过，周围的人纷纷避让行礼。
content_en:
Feige traveled through the sea of ​​clouds for three days, and finally on the morning of the fourth day, the outline of a majestic city emerged from the skyline.
Xuanhuang City,
Even though he was thousands of miles away, Jiang Chen could feel the majestic aura emanating from that city.
The entire city was built against the mountain. The city wall was more than a thousand feet high and was made of a dark golden stone. The flying pavilion lowered clouds a hundred miles outside the city. Yu Ziyuan took back the flying magic weapon.
When he arrived in front of the city gate, Jiang Chen truly realized the majesty of this city.
The thousand-foot-high city gate was wide open, and there was an endless stream of monks coming and going, including many powerful realm emperors. Occasionally, you could see emperor-level beings passing through the sky. They pressed the escape light outside the city gate and lined up to enter the city in an orderly manner.
"Flying is prohibited in Xuanhuang City, and everyone below the emperor must walk into the city."
Yu Ziyuan explained,
"This is a rule set in ancient times, and no one dares to violate it today."
Jiang Chen nodded and glanced at the two hundred-foot-high stone statues on both sides of the city gate. Even after countless years, they still exuded a heart-stopping pressure.
It is definitely not an ordinary stone statue, but a guardian puppet refined with some ancient secret method. Once a powerful enemy invades, it will wake up to face the enemy.
After entering the city, Yu Ziyuan led Jiang Chen through several bustling streets with ease and came to a Ling Mansion that occupies an extremely large area.
The shopkeeper was an old man with white hair and beard. He was at the first level of the Realm Emperor, but his eyes were shrewd. When he saw the two of them entering the door, he immediately greeted them with a smile.
"Two fellow Taoists, do you want to rent the Ling Mansion?"
Yu Ziyuan nodded slightly:
"A high-class spiritual mansion, rented for seven days."
The shopkeeper's eyes swept across the two of them, especially Yu Ziyuan's face, which lingered for a moment. Even though he was well-informed, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes.
But he quickly calmed down and took out a jade slip to check it out.
"What a coincidence, Tianzi No. 9 Courtyard happens to be vacant. The rent is 700 Xuan Crystals for seven days. I wonder if you two..."
Before she finished speaking, Yu Ziyuan had already placed the Xuan Jing on the counter, her movements as casual as if she just threw a few gravels.
The shopkeeper's pupils shrank slightly, and his attitude immediately became more respectful. The person who can take out seven hundred mysterious crystals so casually is definitely not an ordinary monk.
"Wait a moment, you two. I will personally take you two there."
Tianzi No. 9 Courtyard is located in the depths of Ling Mansion. It is a unique courtyard, covering an area of no less than a hundred acres. The Ling rockery and flowing water in the courtyard complement each other, and the aura is richer than many fairylands.
The shopkeeper handed the jade plaque to Yu Ziyuan and said:
"It's a coincidence that you two fellow Taoists are here. At the Xinghui Baoque auction in three days' time, it is said that several rare treasures will be on display. If you two are interested, I can arrange seats for you."
Yu Ziyuan and Jiang Chen looked at each other and said softly:
"Thank you, the shopkeeper."
The shopkeeper waved his hand and said with a smile:
"It's easy. By the way, if you two have free time, you might as well go for a walk in the city's markets.
The shops in Xuanhuang City are second to none in this area, especially the casual repair shops in the West City. Although they are not as good as those big auction houses, they can sometimes find some unexpected surprises. "
After seeing off the shopkeeper, Yu Ziyuan stood in the courtyard and looked at Jiang Chen:
"Fellow Taoist's injury has not healed yet. It's better to adjust your breathing in the Ling Mansion for a day. It won't be too late to go to Fangshi tomorrow."
Jiang Chen shook his head and said:
"It's okay. I have almost recovered from my self-cultivation in the past few days. I just want to go out for a walk and see the scenery of Xuanhuang City."
Yu Ziyuan smiled slightly and did not persuade her again.
After only stopping for a moment to let the maids clean up their residence, the two of them left the Ling Mansion and walked towards the Xishifang that the shopkeeper mentioned.
The main street of Xuanhuang City is more than a hundred feet wide, and there are many pavilions on both sides, each of which exudes extraordinary spiritual energy fluctuations.
Monks were coming and going on the street, and the ones with the lowest cultivation level were above the Star Lord realm. Realm Emperor cultivators could be seen everywhere. Occasionally, you could even see emperor-level warriors passing by proudly. People around them gave way and saluted.
